title: Memory
subtitle: Review, filter, and maintain long-term memory in the instance
scopeBanner: What you can see here follows the current instance. Switching instances changes both the list and the filter options.

embeddingHealth.title: Embedding calls keep failing: model group {{group}}
embeddingHealth.detail: {{kind}}; {{count}} failures in a row since {{since}}, the latest at {{lastFailure}}.
embeddingHealth.noSuccess: Last success: none since this start
embeddingHealth.impact: Memories consolidated meanwhile have no vectors, so recall and the near-duplicate check cannot use them; knowledge base search falls back to keywords. Check this model group's API key, quota and network; it recovers by itself once fixed.
embeddingHealth.missing: {{count}} active memories currently have no vector.
embeddingHealth.missingOnly: {{count}} active memories have no vector (most likely consolidated while embedding was failing), so vector recall and the near-duplicate check cannot use them. The super-user command memory_backfill_vectors fills them in.

kinds.auth: Authentication failed (invalid key or no permission)
kinds.quota: Out of quota or rate limited
kinds.rejected: Rejected by the upstream (wrong model name, parameters or address)
kinds.network: Network failure (cannot connect, timeout or proxy error)

preset.consoleOnly: Console only (conclusions from console-dispatched CC tasks)

filters.searchTooLong: Search is limited to {{max}} characters; the rest was trimmed.

detail.title: Paragraph details
detail.personsHelper: Only non-bot accounts that spoke in the source channel are accepted; this is checked on save.
detail.milestoneRecordNotFound: The affection record this milestone belongs to is not visible or no longer exists.

bulk.noMatch: No memory items match the current filters. They may have been handled by someone else.
bulk.cascade: This also removes {{episodes}} episodes, {{relations}} relations, {{persons}} people, and {{reinforcementLogs}} reinforcement logs.
bulk.partial: Processed {{affected}}; {{failed}} failed and remain in the list.
bulk.countChanged: The count changed. The preview has been refreshed; please confirm again.
bulk.hardDeleteInputLabel: Enter the number of items to delete permanently ({{count}})
bulk.hardDeleteInputHint: Permanent deletion cannot be undone. Type the previewed count exactly before confirming.

hardDeleteNotes.chatRecords: Chat history itself is not deleted; only memory is removed.
hardDeleteNotes.summary: Channel summaries may also cover this content; edit them under Channel summaries if needed.
hardDeleteNotes.promptRounds: Prompt details that referenced these items will show them as permanently deleted.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this memory?
deleteDialog.description: It will no longer be injected or retrieved, but it stays under Deleted and can still be permanently deleted later.

hardDeleteDialog.title: Delete permanently?
hardDeleteDialog.success: Permanently deleted along with {{count}} related records.
hardDeleteDialog.successEpisode: This episode has been permanently deleted.
hardDeleteDialog.episodeDescription: Only this episode is deleted. Its member paragraphs stay and will be grouped again later.

quarantine.restoreSuccess: Restored. It will be retrieved and injected again.

trace.empty: Original messages not found (they may have been cleaned up).
trace.crossChannel: This memory comes from another channel.

flags.sensitiveHint: A sensitive matter about a specific person; only recalled in the chat it came from

focus.title: Focus
focus.hint: Drag, swipe with two fingers, or scroll to pan. Hold Ctrl or Command while scrolling to zoom. Density changes labels, how many nodes are drawn, and link detail.

graph.empty: Nothing to draw yet for the current scope and filters.

panel.title: Details & actions
panel.noActions: This kind of memory is view-only here.

person.note: The name comes from this person's most recent paragraph. With an instance selected, one person's accounts are merged.

groups.personHint: {{total}} people appear in the memories matching the current filters, most items first; expand one to see their latest items
groups.topicHint: The memories matching the current filters fall into {{total}} groups: one per event, items without an event last
groups.showAllInList: {{count}} items in total — open them in the list
groups.emptyPersons: None of these memories records who was involved.

errors.notFoundHint: This record does not exist, or it is not in an instance you can manage.

diff.noChanges: The two versions are the same (whitespace only).
diff.legendRemoved: Red, struck through: in the previous version, removed here

dialog.title: Channel summary
dialog.pauseTooltip: Only stops automatic updates while consolidating; the summary is still injected. To stop injection too, turn off channel summaries in system settings.
dialog.conflict: The summary was just updated; the latest version has been loaded
dialog.conflictReplaced: Your changes were not saved and have been replaced with the latest version
dialog.rollbackPrevious: Roll back to the previous version

memoryState.suppressed: Blocked last round, not injected this round

worldbookState.suppressed: Blocked last round; reference entries were not injected
worldbookState.error: Error; nothing was injected this round

promptRounds.pickChannelHint: Prompt details are recorded per channel; pick one to look at them.

detail.summaryLine: {{cooldownSkipped}} items skipped by cooldown, memory block {{blockChars}} chars
detail.summaryCurrent: That summary version is still the latest
detail.summaryOutdated: That summary version has been updated since
detail.summaryDeleted: That version is no longer kept (only the latest few are)
detail.summaryNone: No summary was injected this round
detail.similarityHint: Vector similarity between this memory and the conversation excerpt at the time
detail.memoryJudgeFallback: Model filter failed; this round fell back to similarity
detail.noItems: No memory item was injected this round

empty.itemsHint: Try different filters, or come back after new memories are formed in a conversation.
empty.episodesHint: Episodes are aggregated from paragraphs on the same topic. Try different filters.
empty.quarantineHint: No memory is quarantined right now.
empty.summariesHint: Once channel summaries are enabled, they are generated automatically while consolidating.
empty.promptRoundsTitle: No records for this channel yet
empty.promptRoundsHint: One row is recorded after each conversation round; retention is configured in system settings.
